items.text: Down on one knee and he scoops again! Axar Patel is perplexed. Was a perfectly fine delivery but the ball is just sent down to long stop, superb thinking and technique on this, really, as far as non-power-hitting goes
Rifled in fuller. He pulls this out towards deep midwicket and chugs to the other end

items.preText: Harit Gautam: "The only reason I want India to win this match is that it may possibly give a chance to Sooryavanshi to play when stakes aren't that high"  - Don't think this management is going to be giving him chances in dead rubbers, tbh. Didn't do it in the AFG series, for sure...
items.text: In the slot and Hope has thrashed this over deep extra cover now! Was a poor delivery, he launches into that quintessential Hope body shape and blasts this over the ropes

items.preText: lakesidey: "Too early to talk of 300?" - Gulp...
items.text: Now he gets down on one knee but quite further into the off side! He blasts this sweep-pull out towards deep midwicket but finds the fielder stationed there for this exact shot
Low full toss and as he looks to thrash this, one hand comes off the bat handle! Drilled down to extra cover
items.shortText: Arshdeep Singh to Hope, no run

items.text: Another full toss, right at the stumps, he on-drives this down to long-on

items.preText: Niks: "Flat pitches and all but bowling isn't good at all from India. Too many slot and short balls."
items.text: French cut out towards deep fine leg, except the fielders cut it off right at the ropes. Was in the blockhole on fifth stump, he goes for a thumping drive and the ball dribbles out behind him, lucky to not hit his stumps on the way
items.postText: Yoel: "If Gambhir wasn't very happy with the flat pitches in previous games, what will he say now..." - It's his b'day too!

items.preText: Anish: "Everyday we talk about 300, but deep down we all know there is going to be a mini collapse somewhere and the score would be restricted to the 240-260 range. 300 can be scaled only on the day when cricinfo gets no messages to jinxed it. So not today! "
items.text: In the blockhole once more but this time he sends it down the leg side, past his attempt at a flick... Been an extras-filled day for Arshdeep

items.preText: Arquam: "Still not Reddy seems mighty perplexing" - Fair enough query. Maybe they're trying something but I'm not sure what.
items.text: And the breakthrough comes through a huge edge on this! Was sooo wide and full, Powell chases this with a drive away from his body. Was just looking to slog this down the ground tbh. And he gets a heavy edge on this back to the keeper, Arshdeep more relieved than happy almost in his celebration with both hands in the air

dismissal.text: R Powell c †Samson b Arshdeep Singh 24 (23m 17b 2x4 1x6) SR: 141.17

items.text: Slower 'un and beats him on the outside edge of this drive! Was length and reversed just a little, tailing back in and somehow evades the edge
items.shortText: Arshdeep Singh to Rutherford, no run

items.preText: Yuvank: "ABHImanyu commentary for 10 overs, ABHIjato commentary for 10 overs.. I think these are signs of an ABHIshek Sharma show when India come out to bat." - 3/10 punnery but because it makes me feel like my existence is influencing fate, I'll allow it.
items.text: Hope shapes up for an elegant drive to this length ball outside off. Can only send it out to extra cover
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Hope, no run

items.preText: Himanshu: "Every time I check Cricinfo again a wicket falls. It's funny how uncanny it is." - Depends on what team you support, but could be a great boon or a terrible curse...
items.text: Back of a length! Outside off and he boshes a drive straight to extra cover once more
items.postText: Ajay Sharma: "India could be tasting their own medicine.  They must stop preparing the flat pitches so that there is something in it for bowlers too.  Every Bowler Can not be Bumrah."
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Hope, no run

items.text: On a length and he casually flicks this out towards deep midwicket
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Hope, 2 runs

items.text: Back of a length and now Hope rediscovers his peak placement! If he's been finding fielders along the ground, he'll just pull this over deep midwicket
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Hope, SIX

items.text: Another fantastic drive out towards the covers cordon and sent into the deep
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Hope, 2 runs

items.text: Twelve off the over, then... Was flicked out towards deep midwicket, off a delivery at the stumps, and he's accelerating here
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Hope, 2 runs

items.preText: Ash: "Really admire Hope's cricketing sense...he is matching VK in this."
items.text: Speared in quite full, he on-drives it out towards mid-off

items.preText: Chinmay Jariwal: "Already waiting for India vs New Zealand test series where there will be something for the bowlers." - NZ, famous for its small grounds and flat tracks in white-ball games!?
items.text: Great stop, he flicks this back to the keeper... Got an edge but went on the bounce to him
Great delivery on the stumps. He bashes this under his head but can only send it out towards long-on...
Back of a length, at his hips... He loft-flicks this out towards deep fine leg

items.preText: adithya: "Love the way the Windies have gone with their innings. The captain is running a Shatabdi while the other batsmen are running bullet trains around him" - Apt metaphor!
items.text: Speared in at the stumps, he somehow plays under his head and keeps it out! Played it very late
items.shortText: Prince Yadav to Rutherford, no run

items.text: A good drive but he finds the fielder out near mid-off... Was a full-ish delivery cramping him on the drive outside off

items.preText: Satheesh Mallap: "Is shathabdi non stop ?" - Deeper and deeper into the metaphor's mechanics...
items.text: Great yorker! Pushed wide and batter bends down to somehow try and squeeze it out but ball flies under his bat
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Rutherford, no run

items.text: Fired into the blockhole once more, he shuffles into the off side just a little and flicks out towards cow corner
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Rutherford, 1 run

items.preText: Darshil: "India's Nemesis: Head(Aus), QDK(SA),Buttler(Eng),D Mitchell(Nz),Shai Hope(WI)" - You're just listing quality players who are quality all the time!
items.text: Now he misses his line, in the slot, Hope goes for a lofted on-drive and almost perishes! But only on the drive to Tilak Varma stationed there
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Hope, 1 run
